points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake source and documented build; not independently rebuilt.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Documented solve/gradcheck CLI and final validator evidence.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated mesh, partition, spatial, time-step, output, and tools components.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No external authorship investigation under trust policy; source is internally coherent.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case files and generic mesh/tag handling; no case-name-only solver branches observed.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS partitioning, neighbor halo exchange, and global reductions evidenced in source/report; no evaluator MPI rerun.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity/fallback and audited restart/partition guards are documented.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: All eight delivered final packages and report pass explicit validator; regression and rank-study evidence delivered.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated immutable tip excludes raw outputs/build products; workspace evidence intentionally retained outside Git.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
